answer_1.quote: We propose P^3 SUM, a summarization model aiming to Preserve the Political Perspectives of news articles.

answer_2.quote: For summarization utility evaluation, we employ Rouge-1/2/L scores and abstractiveness scores.

answer_4.quote: To complement the automatically selected model summaries and the original labels in the POLITICS dataset, we conduct an additional human evaluation to measure the stance preservation and factuality.
answer_4.guideline: measure the percentage of generated summaries that are faithful to the political stances and facts in the original news article
